but found nothing.{end_wait}
There is nothing but years\nof dust.{end_wait}
Dry old books, nothing that\nhelps anyone now.{end_wait}
A sarcophagus. Better not\nto wonder who is inside.{end_wait}
It's glowing hot. Don't\ntouch it.{end_wait}
The surface ripples even\nthough there is no wind.{end_wait}
It's just a stone pillar,\ncold and silent.{end_wait}
It's colder than it\nshould be.{end_wait}
There's no way through here\nby force.{end_wait}
There could be something\nhere. Look closer.{end_wait}
It's pitch black inside.\nIt almost feels like it's\nlistening.{end_wait}
There's nothing unusual,\nwhich is somehow worse.{end_wait}
It looks ready to spring to\nlife. Don't turn your back\non it.{end_wait}
Words are carved into it,\nworn thin by time.{end_wait}
but found nothing.{end_wait}
but finds nothing.{end_wait}
but finds nothing.{end_wait}
Nothing new in these, only\nold and tired ideas.{end_wait}
It's a long way down, too\nfar to see the bottom.{end_wait}
A little warmth returns.\nPP is fully restored.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Ngh... {pause_20_skippable}Hrrngh... {end_wait}
*Hah...* {pause_20_skippable}*Hah...*{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}No, no, nooo!{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
There. That's all I had.{page_break}I hope it was enough.{end_wait}
Grandpa! {actor_name:6}!\nThank gods you're alive!{end_wait}
...Thank you, {actor_name:1}.\nI won't forget this.{end_wait}
Yes, ma'am... I'm trying.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}...{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! Wait! Don't!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}... listen.{end_wait}
Three years later...{end_wait}
Hyah!{end_wait}
Hyaaaah!{end_wait}
What is it, {actor_name:2}?{end_wait}
Fine. Forget I said\nanything.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6},{pause_20_skippable} are you angry\nwith me?{end_wait}
Not now. I can't talk\nabout it.{end_wait}
Come on! Move it!{end_wait}
Huh?{pause_20_skippable} What?{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}'s waiting for us.\nWe shouldn't be late.{end_wait}
But, {actor_name:6}...!{end_wait}
{actor_name:6}...{end_wait}
You patched it well.\nKyle would've approved.{end_wait}
All right. That's the last\nof it. Good work.{end_wait}
I don't believe that for a\nsecond.{end_wait}
I thought so... {actor_name:1}.\nYou can't lie to me.{end_wait}
I thought as much.{end_wait}
Hmm...{pause_20_skippable} I wonder.\nI wonder about a lot.{end_wait}
MA'{pause_20_skippable}AAAAM!!!{end_wait}
Hello, {actor_name:6}. Did you\nsleep at all?{end_wait}
Morning, ma'am. I managed\nan hour or two.{end_wait}
Yes, yes... Good morning.\nIf you can call it that.{end_wait}
And {actor_name:2}, too.\nThe whole lot of you.{end_wait}
Where are you all headed\ntoday? Tell me honestly.{end_wait}
Up Mt. Aleph, with Kraden.\nIt's for our studies.{end_wait}
Climbing that mountain.\nWith Kraden, no less.{end_wait}
No! It's for our studies.\nHonest.{end_wait}
Ah. Alchemy. Of course.{end_wait}
Alchemy is where all\nPsynergy began, they say.{end_wait}
And Mt. Aleph is where it's\nstrongest. You know that.{end_wait}
They say Kraden's the best\nteacher anywhere. Wisdom\nhas its price.{end_wait}
{actor_name:2}, don't! Stop!{end_wait}
Oh! My heart nearly\nstopped!{end_wait}
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to\nstartle you.{end_wait}
Well!{end_wait}
I... I'm sorry, ma'am. I'll\nget out of your way.\nRight now!{end_wait}
Wait! Not there!{end_wait}
Huh?{pause_20_skippable} What's wrong with{em_dash}{end_wait}
Oh, never mind...{end_wait}
You'd better go now, before\nI start thinking too hard\nabout it.{end_wait}
I'll tidy this. You needn't\nstay and watch.{end_wait}
Thank you, ma'am.{end_wait}
Please, call me Dora.{end_wait}
We'll go now. Sorry again.{end_wait}
Wait, {actor_name:2}...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nPlease{pause_20_skippable} watch your step.{end_wait}
Rrr... Rrruff!{end_wait}
Woof!{pause_20_skippable} Woof... woof.{end_wait}
{actor_name:2}, you drive me\ncrazy sometimes!{end_wait}
You're in trouble tonight.\n{pause_20_skippable}Just {pause_20_skippable}wait {pause_20_skippable}and {pause_20_skippable}see.{end_wait}
You there.\nWhat are you doing here?{end_wait}
Us? We're just... walking.{end_wait}
You're the ones who were\nsneaking around earlier!{end_wait}
Go. Quickly.{end_wait}
You're... letting us go?{end_wait}
Let's... let's just go,\n{actor_name:1}. Now.{end_wait}
And all that about the\nelements... what was it?{end_wait}
Oh. {protagonist_name}.\nCome in. Quickly.{end_wait}
You look troubled.\nWhat is on your mind?{end_wait}
Me? Ah... well, yes.\nI suppose I am.{end_wait}
Wait, everyone. Think.{end_wait}
Then what do we do?{end_wait}
Isn't that impossible?\nIt's forbidden.{end_wait}
Why would it be? Because\nthey say so?{end_wait}
Right. We aren't doing\nanything wrong up there.{end_wait}
Then it's decided.{end_wait}
You don't have to be so\nharsh...{end_wait}
There's no need to be\ncruel...{end_wait}
All right.{pause_20_skippable} Let's go.{end_wait}
Go no further. Mt. Aleph is\nawake and it is angry.{page_break}Turn back. Now.{end_wait}
I'm alone out here, in the\nmiddle of all this.{page_break}Did the Great Healer\nforget about me...?{end_wait}
{protagonist_name} examined the\nPsynergy Stone.{end_wait}
It's {actor_name:2}'s chest of\nvaluables. He nearly died\nfor it.{end_wait}
A huge rock. {protagonist_name}\ncan't budge it. Not\nwith bare hands.{end_wait}
I thought Mt. Aleph had{pause_20_skippable}\ngone quiet for good...{end_wait}
My grandson... can {actor_name:2}\nsurvive this? Can any\nof them?{end_wait}
Grandpa, we don't know he's\nup there. Don't say that.{end_wait}
But, Sis,{pause_20_skippable} somebody saw\nthem heading up the\nmountain.{end_wait}
They were loitering here\nwhile I stood watch.\nI let them be.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} and {actor_name:2} went\nto Kraden's house. Like\nalways.{end_wait}
Studying Alchemy, right?\nThat's what they told us.{end_wait}
Yes...{pause_20_skippable} but what does\nthat have to do with\nthe eruption?{end_wait}
Oh no.{pause_20_skippable} It's Grandpa.\nAnd the others.{end_wait}
What do we do,\n{actor_name:1}? Go back up?{end_now}
{actor_name:2}!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
You're alive! Thank the\ngods!{end_wait}
Over here. Both of you.{end_wait}
Where were you?{end_wait}
What happened up there?{end_wait}
Weren't {actor_name:6} and Kraden\nwith you?{end_now}
Taken? Taken by whom?{end_wait}
What do you mean, taken?\nSpeak plainly, boy.{end_wait}
This is more tangled than\nI feared.{end_wait}
Tell us everything that\nhappened on the mountain.\nLeave nothing out.{end_wait}
Come into the Sanctum.\nBoth of you. Now.{end_wait}
We never knew... the true\nSanctum was hidden all\nthis time.{end_wait}
And {actor_name:6} and Kraden...\nthey're prisoners?{end_now}
Taken against their will.\nGods, how cruel.{end_wait}
We can only hope they're\nalive. And unharmed.{end_wait}
Can they be saved? Truly?{end_now}
{actor_name:5} will protect them.\nHe's {actor_name:6}'s brother.\nHe has to.{end_wait}
Then our hope rests with\n{actor_name:5}. May he be strong.\n{end_wait}
Great Healer, you've said\nnothing. What troubles you?{end_wait}
You seem a thousand miles\naway.{end_wait}
That floating stone that\nappeared before {actor_name:1}...{end_wait}
What of it?{end_wait}
I've seen it before.{pause_20_skippable}\nIn dreams. For years.{end_wait}
It came again just now.\nBehind my eyes. And it\nspoke to me.{end_wait}
Just now? You saw it?{end_wait}
It must be the Wise One.\nGuardian of the Elemental\nStars.{end_wait}
It showed me what befell\nyou in Sol Sanctum.{end_wait}
And the eruption? What\ndoes the Wise One say?{end_wait}
Will the mountain take us?{end_wait}
The eruption can't be\nstopped. Not anymore.{end_wait}
Will Vale be...{pause_20_skippable} lost?{end_wait}
Vale will be spared. The\nWise One will turn the lava\naway from us.{end_wait}
Great Healer? Your face...{end_wait}
...There's more. Something\nyou're not telling us.{end_wait}
Something worse than Vale's\nruin is coming.{end_wait}
What could be worse than\nlosing Vale?{end_wait}
A terrible power.{end_wait}
The Elemental Stars hold\nenormous power.{end_wait}
...And Vale has guarded\nthem all this time?{end_wait}
The lighthouses, once lit,\nwill release that power\nupon the world.{end_wait}
And when that power\nis loosed, the whole\nworld will...{end_wait}
The Wise One wants the\nStars back, doesn't it?{end_wait}
This world is ours to save\nor to ruin.{page_break}If we do nothing, we\nruin it ourselves.{end_wait}
A cruel burden...{end_wait}
No salvation is coming.\nWe have to save ourselves.{end_wait}
Then what can we do?{end_wait}
Taking the Stars back is{pause_20_skippable}\ntheir burden alone.{end_wait}
You'd put the fate of the\nworld in the hands of\n{actor_name:1} and {actor_name:2}?{end_wait}
{actor_name:2} is a child. How\ncan he carry such a thing?{end_wait}
The Wise One has spoken.{end_wait}
We are all responsible\nfor this. Every one of us.{end_wait}
Now each of you must\nchoose for yourselves.{end_wait}
I don't know what to do.\n{actor_name:1}... you decide.{end_wait}
You're {actor_name:1}, right?{page_break}The tremors have eased a\nlittle. That's something.\nIt won't last, though.{end_wait}
Lost? Try Vault.{page_break}East a little, then south.\nThey'll take in strangers.\nMaybe.{end_wait}
East along the road, then\nnorth, and you'll reach the\nGoma Range. Bleak country.{end_wait}

The air glitters since the
mountain blew.{page_break}Is it ash... or crushed
Psynergy Stones, falling
like snow?{end_wait}
You saw the Wise One? The\none in the healers' tales?{end_now}
Then you've been blessed.{pause_20_skippable}\nOr cursed. Time will say.{end_wait}
The Wise One held back the\nlava, they say. I'd rather\nnot ask what it costs.{end_wait}
Lunpa, the righteous thief,\nfounded a town up north\nlong ago.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}... your mother has\nbeen crying since you left.\nShe thinks no one hears.{end_wait}

If your Psynergy runs low,
touch a Psynergy Stone.{page_break}But the eruption flung
them everywhere. Who knows
where they landed.{end_wait}
Only two of you out there?\nAren't you afraid?{end_now}
Three of you out there?\nAren't you afraid?{end_now}
Four of you, against all\nthat? Aren't you afraid?{end_now}
Don't wander too deep into\nthe unknown.{page_break}Fighting hopeless odds is\nnot brave. It's foolish.{end_wait}

Courage isn't recklessness.
Know the difference.{page_break}True courage takes caution.
Sometimes it even looks
like cowardice.{end_wait}
Restore your Psynergy\nbefore any dungeon.{page_break}The ones who come back\nalways do.{end_wait}
I'm proud of you, {actor_name:2}.\nMy son... on a quest like\nthis. Come back to me.{end_wait}
You're lucky, {actor_name:2}.{page_break}I'd give anything to go\nwith you. Anything.{end_wait}
Look after my brother,{pause_20_skippable}\n{actor_name:1}. Please.{end_wait}
Who are you?{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} It can't\nbe... You aren't\n{actor_name:1}, are you?{end_now}
{actor_name:1}... No. A lie.{end_wait}
He swore he wouldn't come\nback until it was done.{page_break}My {actor_name:1} keeps his word.\n...Please. Go away.{end_wait}
I don't know who you are.{pause_20_skippable}\nI'm sorry. I can't see\nanyone today.{end_wait}

When I'm your age,
{actor_name:1}, I'll climb
that fence...{page_break}and see the lands beyond.
I swear it.{end_wait}
*Sigh* I even miss\nseeing {actor_name:6} standing\nalone.{end_wait}
I don't blame {actor_name:5}.{page_break}We should've saved him that\nday. We should've.{end_wait}
Look, {actor_name:1}.{pause_20_skippable} That huge\nPsynergy Stone came down\nright on the hut.{end_wait}
Something that big, falling\nout of the sky... it could\nhave been any of us.{end_wait}
Kraden hasn't come back.\nI doubt he will.{end_wait}
Vale lives thanks to the\nWise One... if you believe\nthat.{end_wait}
Since the tremors started,\nno one can climb Mt. Aleph.\nNo one should.{end_wait}
The ground still shakes.\nEveryone says it's over.\nI don't think it is.{end_wait}

The mayor was too kind to
those strangers...{page_break}If he'd driven them off,
none of this would have
happened.{end_wait}
It's quiet for now. But it\ncould blow again. I can't\nsleep.{end_wait}
Vault? That's the town with\nthe tunnel, isn't it?{end_wait}
Past the Goma Range, winter\nis brutal. People freeze.{page_break}I'm glad I don't have\nto go there.{end_wait}

If this glitter is all
that remains of them...{page_break}then Mt. Aleph is in
serious trouble.{page_break}They say the Stones feed
all the mountain's power.{end_wait}
I always believed the Wise\nOne was real...{page_break}Now that I have proof,\nI'm not sure I'm glad.{end_wait}
Even the righteous thieves\ngo bad after a few\ngenerations.{end_wait}
No matter how well she\nhides it,{page_break}{protagonist_name}{possessive_suffix} mother must\nbe so lonely...{end_wait}
You'd be lucky to find a\nPsynergy Stone out there.\nI wouldn't count on it.{end_wait}

I'm worried about you,
{protagonist_name}. You two are like
brothers to me.{page_break}Promise you won't do
anything foolish. Come back
alive. Please.{end_wait}
If Psynergy runs low in a\ndungeon, don't panic.{page_break}Just keep walking.\nIt comes back, slowly.{end_wait}
I wish I could see new\nlands too. Even scary ones.{end_wait}
My brother's strength is\nhis best quality. Let him\ncarry what he can for you.{end_wait}
Why isn't anyone else\ncurious what's beyond this\nfence? Or just afraid?{end_wait}
I'm glad {actor_name:5} is alive.\nI was so afraid for\n{actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} was a good man.\nI still believe in him.\nSomeone has to.{end_wait}
If your Psynergy runs low,\nfind a Psynergy Stone.{page_break}It restores you at once.\nThey're rarer now.{end_wait}
Poor Kraden... dragged off\nto some faraway place.{page_break}I liked that old coot.\nI hope he's still alive.{end_wait}

Vale survived because old
women like me stood our
ground...{page_break}to shield those who
couldn't shield themselves.{end_wait}
Who'd climb that mountain\nafter what it did to us?\nMadness.{end_wait}
I won't feel safe again,\nknowing it could erupt\nany night.{end_wait}
Vale will never trust\ntravelers again.{page_break}Not that I ever did.{end_wait}
Why is everyone crowding\nthe town gate?{end_wait}
What, you haven't heard?{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} and {actor_name:2} are\nleaving Vale today. On a\njourney.{end_wait}
I'd go along if I could.{end_wait}
They say it's going to be\ndeadly dangerous.{end_wait}
So everyone's down there to\nsay good-bye. In case...{end_wait}
Hey, what's wrong?{end_wait}
Strange.\n{actor_name:1}'s mother isn't\nhere to see him off.{end_wait}
You're right. She isn't.{end_wait}
Should we go say good-bye\ntoo?{end_wait}
Yeah. Let's go.{end_wait}
We're counting on you,{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\n{actor_name:1}.{pause_20_skippable} And you, too,\n{actor_name:2}.{end_wait}
Don't drink the water if it\nsmells wrong.{page_break}And take this with you.\nPlease.{end_wait}
I know better than to drink\nbad water, Sis!{end_wait}
Don't listen to him,\n{actor_name:1}!{page_break}He's a pig. He'll eat\nanything not nailed down.{end_wait}
Dora's very late...{end_wait}
Oh!{pause_20_skippable} That's right!{end_wait}
Dora asked me to give\nthis to you, {actor_name:1}.\nShe couldn't come herself.{end_wait}
Guess that's everything,\n{actor_name:1}. Ready?{end_wait}
Think again, {actor_name:2}.{end_wait}
This must be so hard for\nDora...{end_wait}
As {actor_name:2}'s mother, I\nknow exactly how she feels.{end_wait}
But I still have {actor_name:2}'s\nfather. Dora only has\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
She doesn't want you to go,\n{actor_name:1}, but she knows you\nmust. That's what hurts.{end_wait}
If they stand here any\nlonger, they'll never\nleave.{end_wait}
So.{pause_20_skippable} One last farewell.{end_wait}
{text_effect:2}Farewell...{reset_text_style}{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}... was that you?\nDid you lift the boulder?{end_wait}
By the gods! The boulder\nis floating!{end_wait}
Quickly, Feizhi! Pull Hsu\nfree before it falls!{end_wait}
Brace yourself, Hsu.\nI'm pulling. On three.\nOne, two, three!{end_wait}
He's halfway out. A little\nfurther...{end_wait}
Can you hold it a moment\nlonger, {actor_name:1}?{end_now}
Thank you, {actor_name:1}.\nTruly.{end_wait}
You can't let go now!\nYou started this!{end_wait}
Ready? Pulling now!\nOne, two, three!{end_wait}
It worked! Master Hama,\nHsu is free!{end_wait}
We did it, Feizhi.{end_wait}
You saved him, {actor_name:1}.\nThank you.{end_wait}
Master Feh must tend to\nHsu's wounds. Send word.{end_wait}
I'll ask him to clear the\nrocks as well.{end_wait}
Good. If Silk Road stays\nblocked, folks will starve.{end_wait}
Well. {actor_name:1}.{pause_20_skippable} You came\nback. I'm... glad.{end_wait}
This is Vale.{pause_20_skippable}\n...You know that,\n{actor_name:1}. Of course you do.{end_wait}
Back so soon, {actor_name:1}?\nThat can't be a good sign.{end_wait}
You've picked up company\non the road, {actor_name:1}.{page_break}Good. Nobody should\ntravel alone.{end_wait}

The river ran scalding hot
when Aleph erupted. People
thought it was a spring.{page_break}Then it ran cold again.
Rivers don't do that on
their own.{end_wait}
What did you see out there,\n{actor_name:1}? Anything worth\nthe trouble?{end_now}
Nothing? Hm. Your eyes say\notherwise.{end_wait}
Oh? Must've been something.{page_break}Could I come along\nnext time?{end_now}
Ha. Really?{page_break}I was joking. You don't\nhave to be polite.{end_wait}
Yeah. I knew you'd say no.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! You're alive.\nHow have you been?{end_wait}
Welcome home, {actor_name:1}.\nIt's good to see you\nbreathing.{end_wait}
You've made friends out\nthere. Good.{page_break}I wish I had your nerve,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
Mt. Aleph's far side is a\nruin since the eruption.{end_wait}
A crack opened in Mt.\nAleph's northwest side.\nIt's very deep.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! We didn't expect\nyou back so soon. Some\nsaid you wouldn't be.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} has grown so fast.\nHe looks so much like\nhis father now...{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}'s new friends...\nstrange. Are they Adepts?{page_break}Like us? Or something\nelse?{end_wait}
To heat a whole river...\nthat's no ordinary\neruption.{end_wait}

I sense Mt. Aleph isn't the
only place strange things
are happening.{page_break}Crossing the continent
must be harder than ever.{end_wait}
When did you get back,\n{actor_name:1}? Nobody told me.{end_wait}
Do you think {actor_name:1} and\nhis friends could play with\nus again? Like before?{end_wait}
I want to see the world\nand make friends too!{end_wait}
A river of lava burned\neverything on the far side\nof Mt. Aleph.{end_wait}
The crack in Aleph's\nnorthwest is widening.{page_break}At this rate the whole\ncontinent will split apart.{end_wait}
Oh!{end_wait}
It's been so long...{end_wait}
You came back?{end_wait}
Have you been home yet?\nDad's been waiting.{end_now}
Good. He must have been\nhappy.{page_break}He's been sick with\nworry for you.{end_wait}
You have to go see him.\nHe's been worried sick.{end_wait}
...So have I.{end_wait}
Sis...{end_wait}

Don't get me wrong.{pause_20_skippable} I...
I just thought you'd get
in trouble,{page_break}because, you know,
you're not the brightest...{end_wait}
Yeah, all right... Thanks,\nSis.{end_wait}
So,{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} are you home for\ngood? Or...{end_wait}
Not yet...{end_wait}
You're leaving...{pause_20_skippable}\nagain?{end_wait}
Don't push yourself too\nhard,{pause_20_skippable} when you go back.{end_wait}
Hey. How have you been?\nReally.{end_wait}
Oh,{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:2}!\nAnd {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
What happened? You're back\nalready?{end_wait}
Already? Is that how you\ngreet us?{end_wait}
But{em_dash}But they said you\nmight never come back!{end_wait}
And you don't look like\nyou're back for good. Just\npassing through.{end_wait}
Really?{pause_20_skippable} Is it that obvious?{end_wait}
Yeah... You and your\nfriends... You all look\nready to leave.{end_wait}
Sharper than you look.{end_wait}
I'll have to toughen up\nwhile you're gone, right?\nOr else...{end_wait}
The family's fine while\nyou're here. Right?{end_now}
Look after our family while\nI'm gone. All right?{end_wait}
Hey! You're not helping!{end_wait}
WHAT{pause_20_skippable}EVER{pause_20_skippable} YOU{pause_20_skippable} DO{pause_20_skippable},\nguard them while I'm gone.{page_break}Promise me. I'm counting\non you.{end_wait}
Don't push yourself too\nhard,{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} OK?{end_wait}

I can tell just by looking
that you've been through
a lot.{page_break}You look older now.
Much older.{end_wait}
I'll show everyone I'm\nstrong enough{page_break}to protect our family\nand Vale. At any cost.{end_wait}
You're working yourselves\nraw, and I'm worried.\nAre you really all right?{end_wait}
I could go with you if I\nwere older. It's not fair.{end_wait}
I can't stop wondering\nwhat's beyond this fence.{end_wait}

Oh,{pause_20_skippable} is that {actor_name:1}?
Is {actor_name:6}{pause_20_skippable} home yet?{page_break}Promise me, {actor_name:1}...
{pause_20_skippable}Promise me you'll bring
{actor_name:6} with you again.{end_wait}
